chapter_notes_tr: Oakhaven'da lanetin bedensel işaretleri görünür olur. Jori Chapter 3-4 sonunda ücretsiz kalıcı katılır. Kaptan Rusk'ın emrindeki C.V. işareti Cael'e ilk somut ipucudur.

scenes.direction_en: Nixie leads the company beneath bare apple trees. The fruit is still on the branches, but every name board in the orchard is blank.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch3_oakhaven (uneasy layer from the start: the name boards are blank) | post: bgm_ch3_oakhaven

pre_battle_lines.text_en: I warned them. The names are gone anyway.
The men with red glass on their weapons. They are looking for Fadyme.

post_battle_lines.text_en: A village can survive losing a name.
A person should not have to prove they belong in their own home.
Then we give the names back.
Every year I hid, someone else paid my hours.

scenes.direction_en: Jori has wedged her compact forge shield beneath the gate. She is too small to hold the door alone, but refuses to step away. Kera arrives on the Guild road with her rebuilt cart.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_tension (hammered anvil hits in the rhythm) | post: bgm_warmth (Jori held the gate)

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Some hunters can reach Rear heroes. A Front guard can intercept or shield them; formation is set before battle.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: If the gate falls, the forge is next. If the forge falls, they take the tools.
You can replace tools. You cannot replace a village.
I know. That is why I am still standing here.

post_battle_lines.text_en: You held the gate long enough for everyone to run.
I made the shield because I was tired of doors being the only thing between us and danger.
Then walk with us. A shield belongs where people need it.

scenes.direction_en: A red-vial mercenary tips a flask into the village well. Fadyme raises her silver bell focus; the spell takes more from her than she lets anyone see.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_tension | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow — very quiet; the red on the gauntlet is not scored, leave room

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Fadyme, take the left side. I have the well.
It is the mercenary’s blood. Keep the bucket moving.

post_battle_lines.text_en: There is red on my gauntlet.
Then the enemy finally managed to hit you.
I wiped my own blood on his glove. He must not count the drops.

scenes.direction_en: Pippa sings the lost names back to frightened villagers while a bell charm trembles at her wrist.
scenes.music_cue: pre: Pippa's song is diegetic: lute and voice only (record with her VO) | post: bgm_warmth

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Focus builds as heroes act and take hits. Ultimates can be timed by hand or automatically when enabled.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: If the ledger forgets you, I will sing louder than the paper.
People are smiling again. I thought the bell took that too.
Not everything precious can be written down.

post_battle_lines.text_en: I am carrying the names to the refuge. Someone has to keep them safe.
I will go with Mahmut and Fadyme. The village has its gate back.
Then the road has room for one more.
Jori joins permanently as a story recruit.

scenes.direction_en: Captain Rusk raises a signal banner over the orchard road. A volley is already aimed at the well.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_tension, snare roll under the signal banner | battle: bgm_boss_human | post: bgm_ledger_motif on 'Seven notches'

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: A marked hero is the next target. The intent icon and combat log show the warning; shields and guards can redirect the strike.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The order says the heir comes quietly. It says nothing about the village.
Your order is written by cowards.
It was sealed by someone the Crown buried years ago.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Seven notches. Same wax as the seal on your shield. There are letters beneath it: C.V.
Do those initials mean anything to you?
Not yet. The Red Vial ledger may know.
C.V. I saw those letters on my father’s last page.
We should find a healer before we open the order.
Then I will carry it, sealed, until we do.

scenes.direction_en: Three days of orchard roads. Fadyme walks slower on the hills; Mahmut adjusts his pace without comment.
scenes.music_cue: bgm_road (slower tempo than ch2_road: Fadyme walks slower); hint of bgm_mahmut_theme when he adjusts his pace

lines.text_en: We will stop at the next wall.
You stopped at the last wall. And the one before.
You are pacing yourself for me.
I am pacing myself for the walls.
She laughed, and then coughed, and turned her face into her scarf before he could see.

scenes.direction_en: Oakhaven's inn, after the captain falls. Mahmut sets Rusk's sealed order on the table between them. Nixie has stayed behind in the refuge with Oakhaven's Vale children.
scenes.music_cue: bgm_camp (inn version: indoor, fire) → bgm_tension once the sealed order is on the table

lines.text_en: We should open it. Knowledge is the only antidote I trust.
Why does a healer matter for paper?
Because whatever it says, someone at the table may need one afterward.
...The Undercity has the best healers. And the Guild ledger.
